name: mouse-click-test
description: Mouse button and scroll wheel diagnostic tool for macOS and Windows
author: Thien Ngo

scripts.build:mac: tauri build --bundles app --target universal-apple-darwin && node tools/package.mjs universal-apple-darwin
scripts.build:win: tauri build --no-bundle --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && node tools/package.mjs x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:win-arm64: tauri build --no-bundle --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc && node tools/package.mjs aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.icons: node tools/make-icon.mjs build/appicon.png && tauri icon build/appicon.png -o src-tauri/icons
